messages.subject: More data could be read by Treeio ?
parts:
Hello，I use the first example of instructions to learn tree drawing, whose code is in Current Protocols in Bioinformatics（doi: 10.1002/cpbi.96）（https://github.com/GuangchuangYu/ggtree-current-protocols）, when I use 200 or less leafs or branch to draw the tree, it draws the tree picture successfully, however, when I use large more than 260 leafs to generate the tree, it wiil creat a plus sign "+" in the new line of the input data, no more commands could be executed because of "+" sign. Although the "+" can be canceled by push Esc in keyboard, it seems that the tree data not read successfully. Any one can help me? Thanks in advance.
James
